name: The Shops at Montebello
description: The Shops at Montebello is a major regional shopping destination in Montebello, California, serving the greater Los Angeles area. This enclosed mall features a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues, anchored by prominent department stores. Located conveniently near major freeways, it offers a comprehensive shopping experience for families and residents throughout the San Gabriel Valley.
summary: A prominent enclosed regional mall in the San Gabriel Valley offering diverse shopping, dining, and entertainment options for the greater Los Angeles community.
